newsitem.title: USA: Panax Pharmaceutical to merge with Sangen.
newsitem.headline: Panax Pharmaceutical to merge with Sangen.

text.p: Panax Pharmaceutical Co Ltd said Tuesday it had agreed in principal to merge with Sangen Pharmaceutical Co, a drug research company based in Penn Valley, Pennsylvania.
"The transaction is subject to the satisfaction of several contingencies, including ...completion of new debt or equity financing for the combined entity," it said.
The company did not give any details about the transactions and its officials were not immediately available for comment.
